title: Aerodactyl: King of the Sky, Weak on the Ground
premise: Aerodactyl ruled ancient skies, but becomes weak and slow when it touches the ground.
audiencePromise: See why Aerodactyl's sky dominance comes with a surprising ground-level weakness.
openLoop: How can a sky king become so awkward on the ground?
payoff: Aerodactyl owns the open skies, yet its Pokédex entry gives it a weak, slow walk on land.

voice.instructions: Speak quickly and warmly, with sharp emphasis on sky, ground, weak, and slow. Pause briefly before the final choice.

scenes.headline: SKY KING. GROUND WEAKNESS.
scenes.narration: Aerodactyl ruled the sky, but ground makes it weak.
scenes.caption: SKY KING. GROUND PROBLEM.

scenes.headline: KING OF ANCIENT SKIES
scenes.narration: Ancient Pokédex entries picture it ruling skies above the dinosaur age.
scenes.caption: IMAGINED AS THE SKY'S KING

scenes.headline: THE SKY WAS ITS OWN
scenes.narration: It flew through ancient skies as if they belonged to it.
scenes.caption: OPEN SKIES. TOTAL CONTROL.

scenes.headline: THE LANDING CHANGES EVERYTHING
scenes.narration: Then it touches ground, and its walk turns weak and slow.
scenes.caption: FLIGHT: KINGLY • WALK: WEAK AND SLOW

scenes.headline: FEROCIOUS DOESN'T MEAN FAST
scenes.narration: Ferocious or not, its ground walk stays weak and slow.
scenes.caption: ABOVE: DOMINANT • BELOW: AWKWARD
